fonts.mode: Upstream embedded fonts and copied official browser font asset; no separate supplier checkout

checks: Design graph validated before mounting or output; native realpath bounds reject files outside assignment root.
ZIP names, sizes, expanded data, CRC, duplicate paths and embedded content hashes checked without rewriting original native bytes.
Native Save/Save As/Copy route to frozen snapshots; uncertain retries retain snapshot identity, later edits remain dirty and Copy preserves the bound asset.
Bound editor refuses new/open/recover/tab replacement and edit-in-place changes; raw scripts cannot bypass acknowledged Save.
Final core and every recorded adapter input hash match the reviewed files; three focused package/container/native-boundary tests pass.

additionalLinkedDesignLoop.scope: Actual official native CLI → actual frozen final WASM and adapter → local isolated filesystem-backed immutable host receipt → official native continuation. This additional linked-design loop did not use the BFF/private Storage.
additionalLinkedDesignLoop.nativeFixtureRecipe: A new linked design was explicitly saved with file.save_as before packaging, yielding a relative link. CLI run --out alone can retain an absolute newly inserted source path, which the packager correctly rejects.

separateActualBffEvidence.scope: Actual createEditorHost/local authenticated BFF/private Storage immutable saves and hash-checked downloads; separate single-file parametric model. Local parent/editor, isolated QA project.

limits: The linked graph exercise adds local host evidence; it does not upgrade its scope to the separate BFF run.
No employee LLM turn, remote workstation operation, CDN publication or production rollout is claimed.
Private reference IDs, receipts, signed URLs, temporary evidence paths and screenshots are excluded.
